reason: This PR looks central and risky enough for deep review. It refines the core Executor interface and touches 15 executor files spanning the execution entry path (`adapter.go`, `builder.go`, `executor.go`), internal executor contract (`internal/exec/executor.go`), and many concrete executors (`join`, `merge_join`, `index_lookup*`, `index_merge_reader`, `point_get`, `batch_point_get`, `insert`, `cte`, `coprocessor`, `admin`). Interface-contract changes in these paths can easily introduce high-severity runtime correctness regressions around open/next/close behavior, row production, error propagation, transaction side effects, and executor lifecycle consistency across many statement types.
